mapper.select: select s.id settlementId,s.sharing_no settlementNo,s.order_id orderId,o.order_no orderNo, s.merchant_id merchantId,coalesce(m.merchant_name,'未知商家') merchantName,s.total_amount totalAmount, s.platform_commission_amount commissionAmount,s.merchant_amount merchantAmount,s.commission_rate commissionRate, s.sharing_status settlementStatus,s.created_at createdAt,s.shared_at settledAt from payment_profit_sharing_record s join order_trade o on o.id=s.order_id left join merchant_profile m on m.id=s.merchant_id and m.deleted=0 where s.deleted=0 and s.sharing_status=#{status} order by s.created_at desc limit #{offset},#{size}
